label: A wire as a distributed RC line
section: A wire as a distributed RC line
subgoals: Multiply per-unit-length resistance and capacitance by the length
Integrate shared resistance times capacitance along the wire
Halve the total RC product to get the Elmore delay

label: The 0.38 RC and 0.69 RC rules
subgoals: Compute the total RC product of the wire
Multiply by 0.38 for the distributed 50 percent delay
Contrast it with the 0.69 lumped estimate

label: Quadratic growth with length
subgoals: Scale the delay with the square of the wire length
Divide the wire into k segments of RC over k squared each
Sum the segment delays to get the total over k
